annotations.text:
Stage 2 of stormlight web — a second client on the same windrunner daemon.

Layout keeps the TUI's DNA: workspaces → agent roster → Spanreed pane. Palette, status glyphs (● ◆ ○ ✓), and dot-separated footer hints lifted from internal/theme.

The Wall: every agent's terminal live at once — the thing terminal cells can't do. Each card is its own xterm.js pane on the same attach stream.

Amber border + band = waiting for input. Click a card (or ⏎) to focus it.
Transcript as rendered markdown: prose, highlighted code, tool calls as collapsible rows. Reading what an agent DID is the part cells serve worst.

Diff tab: every agent works a worktree, so every agent has a reviewable diff — review the work product without walking into the terminal.

The one v1 scope question: this is the only tab that needs the API to know git, not just the daemon.
